sources.quote: A supplier may deliver a part only if the approved supplier list contains an approval for that supplier, that part, the receiving site and the customer.
the audit qualifies the company. Part approvals stay as they are.

findings.why: The ASL covers PN-050 for Aurelia at Beinasco, and the only approved source is SUP-G. There is no approval for Meccanica Chisone (SUP-C) on PN-050. The 2026-11-06 return to approved status qualifies the company only and does not approve any part.

sources.quote: The supplier shall obtain written approval from Aurelia (PPAP resubmission) before shipping parts
Aurelia shall be notified of every planned change at least 90 days before implementation.

findings.why: PN-050 belongs to PRG-X, which is an Aurelia program. Revision 4 is in force and replaces revision 3. It requires written approval (PPAP) for a change of source and 90 days' notice. Nothing in force covers this change. Approval is per part number and per site.

sources.quote: Chisone is qualified for 6061-T6 and 6082-T5 only.

findings.why: The drawing requires steel 42CrMo4. Meccanica Chisone is qualified only for aluminium (6061-T6 and 6082-T5) and has no capability for 42CrMo4. Its commodity is aluminium extrusions and blanks, so it cannot meet the drawing material.

sources.quote: A change of source requires a material certificate (EN 10204 type 3.1) from the new supplier for the drawing material. Missing certificates are an open question for the supplier quality engineer.

findings.why: SUP-C has 3.1 certificates only for MAT-6061-T6 and MAT-6082-T5. There is no 3.1 certificate for MAT-42CRMO4. The supplier quality engineer (Elena Gallo) needs to follow this up.
